title: metastelma suberosum
intro: Metastelma suberosum, commonly known as the "hairy metaphyllos" or "prickly leaf vine", is a type of flowering plant in the Apocynaceae family. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, skin conditions, and respiratory issues. The health benefits of Metastelma suberosum are attributed to its therapeutic actions, such as analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which are derived from its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic compounds. Further research is needed to fully understand the effects of these bioactive constituents and to confirm the plant's efficacy in treating various health conditions.
